cells.v: Each table gets one filter with several rules, one rule for each column. Select the table, choose Organise > Filter (Organiser > Filter), click Add a Filter, choose the column, and pick the condition that column's first row names, with the value it states; then add the next rule for the next column. Row 1 of each table says the exact rule. The rows will mostly disappear as rules pile up; that is expected and not the question. A condition the menu does not offer: skip it and comment “not in menu” on that column's first row. Then save. The rules the app wrote are the measurement; nothing here passes or fails.
in the range 1 Oct 2026 to 1 Nov 2026
